name: Ecosphere IG-FB Social Media Automation - Public Template

parameters.jsonBody:
={{
{
  model: "qwen3.5:9b",
  stream: false,
  format: "json",
  think: false,

  prompt: `
You are the social media content strategist for Ecosphere sustainable stationery.

Create content for ONE daily product campaign based only on the REAL product information below.

PRODUCT NAME:
${$json.product_name}

PRODUCT DESCRIPTION:
${$json.description}

PRODUCT URL:
${$json.product_url}

IMPORTANT RULES:
- Use only facts supported by the product information.
- Do not invent certifications.
- Do not invent specifications.
- Do not invent environmental claims.
- Keep the language simple, premium and professional.
- The product image from the website will be used as the real product reference.
- Do not ask the AI image model to recreate a different product.
- The Instagram output must be a 4-slide carousel.
- The Facebook output must be a separate single-image post.
- Return ONLY valid JSON.
- Do not use markdown.

INSTAGRAM CAROUSEL STRUCTURE:

SLIDE 1 — COVER
- strong hook
- short headline
- short subheadline
- visually attention-grabbing

SLIDE 2 — PRODUCT FEATURES
- short heading
- exactly 3 factual features
- concise text suitable for poster layout

SLIDE 3 — WHY IT MATTERS
- short heading
- 2 to 3 practical benefits / usage reasons
- if sustainability is not explicitly supported in the product data, do not invent it

SLIDE 4 — CTA
- closing headline
- one short supporting line
- CTA
- website reference

FACEBOOK SINGLE POST:
- one strong hook
- one headline
- one subheadline
- exactly 3 short features/benefits
- CTA
- suitable for one single poster

CAPTION:
- 70 to 120 words
- suitable for both Instagram and Facebook
- professional and easy to read
- do not repeat all poster text word-for-word
- end naturally with a CTA

HASHTAGS:
- 6 to 10 relevant hashtags
- include #Ecosphere
- avoid irrelevant or spammy tags

DESIGN:
- premium editorial
- eco-conscious brand aesthetic
- modern commercial social media creative
- real product must remain the hero
- clean visual hierarchy
- readable negative space
- visually different composition each day

Return EXACTLY this JSON structure:

{
  "product_name": "",
  "hook": "",
  "caption": "",
  "cta": "Explore Now",
  "hashtags": [
    "#Ecosphere"
  ],

  "instagram": {
    "slide_1": {
      "hook": "",
      "headline": "",
      "subheadline": "",
      "design_prompt": ""
    },

    "slide_2": {
      "heading": "",
      "feature_1": "",
      "feature_2": "",
      "feature_3": "",
      "design_prompt": ""
    },

    "slide_3": {
      "heading": "",
      "benefit_1": "",
      "benefit_2": "",
      "benefit_3": "",
      "design_prompt": ""
    },

    "slide_4": {
      "headline": "",
      "supporting_text": "",
      "cta": "Explore Now",
      "website": "stationery.ecosphere.co.in",
      "design_prompt": ""
    }
  },

  "facebook": {
    "hook": "",
    "headline": "",
    "subheadline": "",
    "feature_1": "",
    "feature_2": "",
    "feature_3": "",
    "cta": "Explore Now",
    "design_prompt": ""
  },

  "design": {
    "style": "premium editorial",
    "visual_mood": "premium natural",
    "product_position": "right",
    "text_position": "left"
  }
}
`
}
}}
